items.source: An instance of this class is typically declared as a bean with the name "forwardedHeaderTransformer" and detected by WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext), or it can also be registered directly via WebHttpHandlerBuilder.forwardedHeaderTransformer(ForwardedHeaderTransformer).
items.translation: 该类的一个实例通常被声明为名为 "forwardedHeaderTransformer" 的 bean，并通过 WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext) 检测，或者也可以通过 WebHttpHandlerBuilder.forwardedHeaderTransformer(ForwardedHeaderTransformer) 直接注册。

items.source: Apply and remove, or remove Forwarded type headers.
items.translation: 应用和移除，或移除转发类型标头。

items.source: Whether the request has any Forwarded headers.
items.translation: 请求是否包含任何 Forwarded 标头。

items.source: Whether the "remove only" mode is on.

Enable mode in which any "Forwarded" or "X-Forwarded-*" headers are
removed only and the information in them ignored.
items.translation: 启用仅移除任何“Forwarded”或"X-Forwarded-*"标头并忽略其内容的模式。

items.source: apply in interface Function<ServerHttpRequest, ServerHttpRequest>
items.translation: `apply 在接口 `Function<ServerHttpRequest, ServerHttpRequest>` 中。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze, Mengqi Xu
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze, Mengqi Xu

items.source: You can also configure the ForwardedHeaderFilter with removeOnly, in which case it removes but does not use the headers.
items.translation: 您也可以使用removeOnly配置 ForwardedHeaderFilter，在这种情况下，它会移除但不使用这些标头。

items.source:
There are security considerations for forwarded headers since an application
cannot know if the headers were added by a proxy, as intended, or by a malicious
client. This is why a proxy at the boundary of trust should be configured to
remove untrusted Forwarded headers that come from the outside.
items.translation: 由于应用程序无法确定这些标头是由代理按预期添加的，还是由恶意客户端添加的，因此对于转发标头存在安全注意事项。这就是为什么应在信任边界处的代理被配置为移除来自外部的不可信 Forwarded 标头的原因。

items.source: removeOnly - whether to discard and ignore forwarded headers
items.translation: removeOnly - 是否丢弃并忽略转发标头
